capabilities: Insert images from an Immich server via a thumbnail gallery
Upload pasted or dragged images to Immich automatically
Connect to multiple Immich servers through named profiles
Prompt to trash or delete Immich assets when links are removed
Render Immich links inline in Live Preview and Reading view
extras: Full documentation (English/Korean), usage, architecture, and troubleshooting guides are hosted externally; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted and dragged images as files inside the vault, which grows the vault; this offloads them to an external Immich photo server.

relations.evidence: store note images in your own Immich server instead of inside the vault

summary: Lets you browse, insert, and upload note images to a self-hosted Immich server instead of storing them inside the vault.
